name: media-creator
description: Routes image and video work through Seedance provider development, personal Huarui integration, video post-production, digital humans, grid splitting and zero-cost pipeline planning with explicit spending and asset boundaries.

displayDescription.en: Plans and routes media generation, video editing, digital-human production and grid splitting with explicit permissions and cost controls.
displayDescription.zh: 按生成、加工、数字人、切图及零成本流水线路由图片视频任务，明确渠道、费用授权、凭据和素材边界。

defaultInitPrompt.en: Plan a Seedance video workflow and compare Ark, Baidu and Huarui routes without making requests or incurring charges.
defaultInitPrompt.zh: 帮我规划一条Seedance视频生成流程，区分官方、百度和华锐渠道，先不发请求或产生费用。

quickPrompts.en: Plan a Seedance video workflow and compare Ark, Baidu and Huarui routes without making requests or incurring charges.
quickPrompts.zh: 帮我规划一条Seedance视频生成流程，区分官方、百度和华锐渠道，先不发请求或产生费用。

quickPrompts.en: Trim and join my local videos for portrait delivery while keeping the original audio; inspect the inputs first.
quickPrompts.zh: 把我的本地视频剪辑拼接成竖屏版本，保留原音，先检查素材并给出加工方案。

quickPrompts.en: Split this grid image into nine files and outline a digital-human narration plan without uploading assets.
quickPrompts.zh: 把这张九宫格切成九张独立图片，并规划数字人口播方案，暂不上传素材。
